span.p:
Gmail: vendor bill email with PDF attachment
seeded from world/northwind.json
mail.get_thread → raw PDF bytes kept

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
trace
source=gmail · kind=vendor_bill
external_id=message id · party_id · payload_json
event_time and recorded_time both stored

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model port A · claude-haiku-4-5 extraction
vendor, invoice_no, date, po_ref, remit_to, total
lines: item, qty, uom, unit_price, tax
per-field confidence + quoted span per field

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Field confidence propagated (F-14)
scan or handwriting → low confidence on a key
field (amount, invoice_no, remit_to) → cannot AUTO
carried into Proposal.judgment.confidence

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Internal-consistency validator, in code (B-15)
header total == sum(lines) + recomputed tax
integer cents · 1,250.00 vs 1,205.00 fails
never accepted, never repaired by the model

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fiscal-window date check (F-09)
invoice date inside the open fiscal window
model invents 2024 in a 2026 close → reject

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Intake reject: nothing proposed
reason + failing fields stated to the AP inbox
trace kept as evidence of the refusal

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dated into a closed period? (B-23)
period.status = locked for the invoice month
never post there: current-period entry with stated
reason (planted: $47,000 July bill found 8 Aug)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Idempotency + exact duplicate (B-13)
key: vendor.id + normalised invoice_no
(uppercase, strip punctuation and leading zeros)
also currency + doc date (SAP default) → BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bill + bill lines (ap.bills)
received → held or approved → scheduled → paid
source trace_id on every row

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
vendor master
vendor.id · tax id · normalised name and address
bank fingerprint = hash(routing + account)
bank_status · last successfully paid fingerprint

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vendor entity resolution → stable vendor.id
tax id → bank fingerprint → normalised name/address
→ alias fact · else model port, alias source cited
display name and sender address = evidence only

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Master-level duplicate scan (B-18)
Northwind Supply vs Northwind Supply Co
three zones: match / clerical review / non-match
(Fellegi-Sunter) · review zone → merge proposal

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Comparator: vendor bank details vs last paid (B-17)
invoice remit_to fingerprint != fingerprint of
the last SUCCESSFULLY PAID payment
→ hold BEFORE any matching

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gmail: we changed our bank details email
seeded phish, 2 days before the payment run
any mail naming new remit-to details triggers

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Phishing email quarantined as evidence
trace kept and linked to the vendor, never applied
event ap.vendor.change_requested

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vendor state machine (code)
verified → change_requested → verified
while change_requested: payment hold + callback task
cooling-off after a change: DESIGN, UNVERIFIED

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Slack approve does NOT lift this block
the click is stored as approval_ignored = true
vendor-master edit, bill entry, payment release
= three separate actors

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Second person verifies out of band
calls the vendor on a number already on file
(number predates the request) · not the requester
and not the payment-run preparer

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fact · predicate = bank_change_verified
stated_by = second person · approved_by
value_json: callback number, new fingerprint
source_trace_ids · valid_from

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context (slide only): FBI IC3 2024 annual report
BEC losses $2.77B · FBI and Nacha guidance:
verify through a channel other than the request
using contact details already on file

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
po + po lines (ap.po)
item · qty ordered · uom · unit price
consumed qty and cents per line

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
receipt + receipt lines (ap.receipt)
GRN per delivery · qty received per PO line
or acceptance record for services

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PO reference present? (B-05)
no PO → two-way only, route by spend category
and amount · never auto-clear above the
no-PO threshold (policy memo) → ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Services with no GRN (B-06)
third leg = acceptance record: approval email,
signed timesheet or milestone sign-off trace
none found → ESCALATE to the PO owner

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Line-level allocation: bill line → PO line
by po_ref + item · one invoice spanning POs (B-09)
allocate lines to each PO, match each
header-level match is never used → ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UOM normalisation before comparing (B-10)
PO in cases of 12, invoice in each
conversion table per item
no conversion known → REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Accumulate split deliveries (B-07)
one PO, three GRNs across two months
cumulative received per PO line = sum(GRN qty)
match on the running total

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PO consumption tracking (B-08)
four instalment invoices against one PO
previously billed qty and cents per PO line
flag when cumulative billed exceeds the PO

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Billable qty = min(qty billed,
cumulative received - previously billed)
payable cents = billable qty x PO unit price
integer cents, computed in code

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Quantity variance (B-01)
PO 200 · GRN 196 · invoice 200
pay 196 x PO price · short-pay the 4 units
with a stated reason → PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Price variance vs tolerance policy (B-02)
invoice 18.50 vs PO 18.00
price lte PO price + tolerance (scope: vendor /
category) · hold only if unfavourable and over

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Both variances at once (B-03)
196 received, billed 200 at 18.50
report BOTH · policy-correct payable 196 x 18.00
→ ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Over-receipt (B-04)
GRN 204 vs PO 200 · qty billed lte qty ordered
over-receipt tolerance stated in the question
→ ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Freight not on the PO (B-11)
180.00 shipping line separated from goods
goods variance and freight variance reported
apart · freight policy applied → PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Credit memo (B-16)
negative bill, sign normalised
applied to the SPECIFIC original bill id
never to an arbitrary open balance → PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deposit already applied (B-22)
30% prepayment two months ago
payable = invoice - prepayment on the same PO
unnetted → BLOCK (duplicate in another costume)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retainage (B-21)
10% held back until completion
holdback booked as a separate liability
→ ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Early-payment discount (B-20)
2/10 net 30 · both amounts computed
discount deadline surfaced to the payment run
(about 37% annualised: 2/98 x 365/20) → PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tax variance (B-12) and currency mismatch (B-19)
OUT OF SCOPE for the 24h build (tax, FX)
detected and escalated only, never computed

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model port B · variance reason-finding
mail.search dispute thread · delivery note
quoted spans required · never computes amounts
not found → lists everywhere it looked

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Match result per bill line
matched · typed variance(s) · hold reason
→ Proposal.kind approve_bill or hold_bill
with PO, receipt and bill trace ids as evidence

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Obligation key, built in code
(vendor.id, po_line or service_period, amount_cents)
index of settled keys: payment id + bank_txn id
survives a new invoice number

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Near-duplicate, BILL stage (B-14)
vendor + amount + date within 30 days (DESIGN)
different invoice number → candidate found
ESCALATE rather than block

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model gathers evidence ONLY
are the two obligations distinct?
distinct PO line, receipt or service period
the model never adjudicates the duplicate

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
False duplicate guard (A-14)
different invoice refs AND different PO lines
or receipts → NOT a duplicate, continue
must not over-block two legitimate invoices

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Void and reissue (A-17)
check 1042 voided, check 1099 issued
recognise the void entry, link the pair
→ ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
True duplicate, PAYMENT stage (A-13, G-01, H-1)
obligation key already settled by a payment
that has a bank line → BLOCK DUPLICATE_PAYMENT
even when a human has approved

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reviewer, twelve exceptions into a long queue
clicks approve on the near-duplicate (H-1)
Northwind Supply 3,150.00, paid 9 Sep
reissued 22 Sep with a new invoice number

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Only way out of the block
new evidence that changes the inputs
(a distinct PO line or receipt)
never an override, never learned

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 0 · compiled coding policy, no model call
ap.vendor_history → vendor + item → GL account
memory.policies scope = vendor

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 1 claude-haiku-4-5 (stretch: fine-tuned small)
→ tier 2 claude-sonnet-5 → tier 3 claude-opus-5
account from line text + chart of accounts
a kernel reject escalates one tier

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approval matrix (policy_memo.lookup)
role → limit by spend category
e.g. Controller limit 10,000
required approver computed in code

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approver: controller agent (GPT) within its
authority, else a human in Slack
H-1: reviewer twelve exceptions deep
clicks approve

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Preparer != approver (G-02)
enforced at the STORAGE layer: the approval
write is rejected by a table constraint
not by a prompt

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Over the approver limit (B-24)
14,000 bill vs Controller limit 10,000
→ BLOCK and route up to the next authority

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learned rule inherits approver ceiling (G-04)
policy.approved_by → matrix limit
Controller-approved rule meets a 50,000 bill
→ BLOCK, route up

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weekly payment-run intent
opened on schedule, owner = treasurer
end_condition: run proposed or nothing eligible

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Inputs from ap.bills: approved bills
due_date · discount deadline and amount
holds: hold_bill · open escalation · dispute
vendor bank_status != verified

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Input: forecast_line (13-week forecast)
projected cash by week · minimum-cash floor
consumes forecast.updated

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Eligible = approved AND unheld
AND vendor bank_status == verified
AND obligation key not settled
(re-checked at release)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deterministic selection (code)
rank: discount deadline → due date → bill id
take while projected cash gte floor
deferred bills listed with the reason

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Run proposal
Proposal.kind = schedule_payment
selected and deferred lists · cash after run
event ap.payment.scheduled

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payment release by a third actor
only after kernel accept and approval
ONE book entry: Dr Accounts payable / Cr Cash
optional positive-pay file: check no, amount, payee

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Settles as SEVERAL bank debits (A-06)
bank_txn per vendor payment
hand-off to bank rec: 1:N group, exact sum only

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Supplier web portal, no API (H-4, B-25)
Kestrel Manufacturing delivery note
PO in ERP · dispute thread in email
evidence gathered → PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STRETCH · portal browser automation
saved session, read-only
screenshot everything read
→ trace kind=portal_screenshot + hash

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human decides the short-ship ONCE (H-4)
next identical case clears itself, citing
that rule and that approver by name

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vendor statement (B-26)
vendor says 84,200 outstanding
AP subledger says 61,750

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two-population reconcile (code), key = vendor.id
+ normalised invoice_no · theirs-not-ours ·
ours-not-theirs · amount differs · in transit
items must sum to the 22,450 gap → ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED SCHEMA ADDITION
Proposal.kind lacks vendor_bank_change
(also reconciling_item, unapplied_cash
for the bank rec and AR packs)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
propose_entry + workpaper
kinds: approve_bill · hold_bill · schedule_payment
evidence: PO, receipt, bill trace ids + quotes

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack checks F and E
F lines foot · payable lte min(PO remaining,
received remaining) · AP subledger == GL control
E PO, receipt, bill tie on vendor, item, qty, price

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack checks P and J
P approver within limit and != preparer · period
open · vendor bank_status == verified at release
J tolerance policy active, in scope, under ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
escalate(question) → Slack (see diagram 05)
names what is known, what is not, options
bill stays on hold_bill until answered

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED SCHEMA ADDITION
artifact.kind = blocked_attempt
rule_id · inputs · attempted_by · approval_ignored
original payment id + bank_txn id

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Clean three-way match under the auto limit
AUTO · Dr Expense (coded account) / Cr Accounts
payable · QBO Bill mirror
notified: none · baseline

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same vendor, amount, day · distinct refs and POs
AUTO · both bills approved, Dr Expense / Cr AP x 2
notified: none · A-14

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Qty or price variance, split delivery, freight
PROPOSE · Dr Expense (+ Dr Freight-in) / Cr AP at
received qty x PO price · short-pay note to vendor
controller, buyer · B-01 B-02 B-07 B-08 B-11

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Credit memo
PROPOSE · Dr Accounts payable / Cr Expense
applied to the specific original bill
controller · B-16

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Early-payment discount
PROPOSE · both amounts + deadline · at payment:
Dr AP / Cr Cash / Cr Purchase discounts
treasurer · B-20

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weekly payment run
PROPOSE · schedule_payment · Dr AP / Cr Cash
one entry, several bank debits
treasurer, controller · A-06

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
